privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TarkovDex is a non-commercial fan site with no accounts and no login. Below is what the site actually processes, and how cookies are used by advertising and third-party services.

collected.title: What we do not collect
collected.body:
There is no sign-up and no login, so we do not collect or store personally identifying information such as your name, email address or phone number.
Our hosting provider (Vercel) may temporarily process technical records — IP address, request time, browser type — to operate and secure the service. TarkovDex does not retain those records separately or combine them with anything else.

localStorage.title: What is stored in your browser
localStorage.body:
Exactly one value is kept in your browser's local storage: your PvP/PvE mode choice. It never leaves your device and is never sent to our server.
Clearing site data in your browser removes it.

ads.title: Advertising and cookies
ads.body:
This site may serve advertising through Google AdSense. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this site or other sites.
Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visits to this and other sites. You can opt out of personalised advertising in Google Ads Settings (google.com/settings/ads), and out of third-party vendor cookies collectively at aboutads.info.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services used
thirdParty.body:
Game data: fetched server-side from the public json.tarkov.dev API. Your browser does not connect to it directly.
Hosting: Vercel.
Advertising: Google AdSense.
Donations: Ko-fi. Once you follow the support link, payment and personal data are handled entirely under Ko-fi's own policy.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
Because this site holds no personally identifying information, there is in practice no personal data to request deletion of.
You can clear the browser-stored value yourself at any time, and opt out of advertising cookies through the links above. For anything else, contact us at the address below.
